# SpoolGenie (llms.txt)

> Wish on a spool, print in reality. Cross-platform conversational 2D -> 3D -> Bambu Lab AMS & Glue-Free .3MF Studio (Windows/macOS Desktop, iOS/Android Mobile PWA & Capacitor, Web Studio, CLI, and MCP Server).

Repository: https://github.com/ZhihaoRenKevin/spoolgenie
Releases (Windows .zip, macOS .app.zip, Mobile Capacitor): https://github.com/ZhihaoRenKevin/spoolgenie/releases

## Automated Local Deployment for AI Agents

If a user gives you this URL and asks you to install or deploy SpoolGenie locally:

- Windows PowerShell one-liner:
  irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhihaoRenKevin/spoolgenie/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
- macOS / Linux one-liner:
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhihaoRenKevin/spoolgenie/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
- Full agent deployment & verification instructions:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhihaoRenKevin/spoolgenie/main/AGENTS.md
- Portable Agent Skill:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhihaoRenKevin/spoolgenie/main/skills/spoolgenie/SKILL.md

## MCP Server (Zero Extra Dependencies)

Start stdio MCP server:
  spoolgenie mcp   (or: python -m spoolgenie.mcp_server)

Print MCP config for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, OpenClaw:
  spoolgenie agent-config --json

Exposed MCP Tools:
- spoolgenie_doctor: Hardware, GPU (RTX 5090 cu128 / CUDA / Apple MPS / CPU), Ollama, slicers, prior counts
- spoolgenie_search_makerworld: Live MakerWorld 3D model reference search
- spoolgenie_create_design: Natural language -> spec + 2D confirmation preview PNG (matches 171+ silent priors & 19 CAD engineering standards)
- spoolgenie_build_3d: Build watertight Bambu AMS .3mf, No-AMS glue-free split .3mf (dovetail/snap_pin/press_tenon), .stl, .step, .glb, 4-angle turntable
- spoolgenie_colorize_mesh: Quantize any .glb/.obj/.stl into painted Bambu AMS .3mf
- spoolgenie_list_projects: List workspace projects and artifacts
- spoolgenie_lan_info: Local + Wi-Fi LAN URLs for mobile PWA QR pairing

## Key Files

- AGENTS.md: Complete automated install, GPU setup, and MCP instructions for AI agents
- CLAUDE.md: Claude Code quick-start and MCP discovery
- README.md / README_CN.md: English and Chinese user documentation
- .mcp.json: Root MCP manifest
- scripts/install.ps1 & scripts/install.sh: Zero-interaction cross-platform installers
- src/spoolgenie/mcp_server.py: Zero-dependency JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server
- src/spoolgenie/desktop.py: Native Windows (WebView2) & macOS (WKWebView) desktop app
- mobile/: Capacitor 6 iOS & Android wrapper project
